<div class="table-caption"><strong>Table 1.</strong> P-scores by wave for selected regions. P-scores by wave for selected European countries (age: 60-79) and U.S. states (age: 65-84) with high and low vaccination rates. Regions are ordered by decreasing vaccination coverage as of mid-2021.</div>
